title: Cocycle calculation with an abelian injective target
statement: For schemes X and Y and a morphism f:X → Y [def-pc-scheme], module sheaves A on Y and F on X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a module injective resolution J of A [def-sp-injective-resolutions], an abelian injective resolution R of the underlying sheaf of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and an augmentation-compatible lift L of a coefficient map c from f⁻¹A to F, the adjoint of L on global sections computes inverse image on Ext followed by c [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] under abelianResolutionIso(Y,J) [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-normalization] and abelianInjectiveResolutionIso(X,F,R). The sections identification is prescribed by top-open restriction. There is no target module resolution I or comparison map from I.

source.place: Tag 01F8 (lemma-functorial-derived) and equation 01F9 (equation-functorial-derived); Tag 06XR (lemma-ext-compute) for Ext computed with an injective resolution; Tag 03FD for the source acyclic resolution.

proof.text: The forgotten augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. Lift it to a genuine abelian injective resolution I of the underlying source. The existing evaluation theorem identifies the prescribed source comparison with the comparison through I.

Exact inverse image preserves the augmentation quasi-isomorphism. Lift c from inverse image of I to R. Its composite with the source comparison and the supplied L agree after the augmentation. Extend by zero to integer complexes, apply homotopy uniqueness into the injective target and restrict back. Mapping this homotopy through direct image, adjunction unit and sections gives equal homology maps.

Use the proved genuine-injective counit cocycle calculation. Naturality of the adjunction unit factors the replacement section map through the mapped source comparison. Homology functoriality, the source evaluation identity and the homotopy equality give the original assertion with arbitrary R and L.

from.place: The abelian counit resolution calculation, cocycle/adjunction step before comparison with a target module resolution.

lean.statement:
theorem abelian_counit_cocycle_calculation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (A : Y.Modules) (F : X.Modules) (J : InjectiveResolution A)
    (c : (invImage f).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).obj A) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F))
    (R : InjectiveResolution
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).obj F))
    (L : ((invImage f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
      (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) ⟶ R.cocomplex)
    (hL : (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (invImage f) (.up ℕ) 0).inv.app
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).obj A) ≫
      ((invImage f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℕ) 0).inv.app A ≫
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℕ)).map J.ι) ≫ L = (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map c ≫ R.ι)
    (s : abelianPushforward f ⋙ abelianSections Y ≅ abelianSections X)
    (hs : ∀ G, s.hom.app G = G.obj.map
      (eqToHom (by simp) : op (f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) ⟶ op (⊤ : X.Opens)))
    (p : ℕ) (x : H A p) :
    ((HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
      (((abelianSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (abelianAdjunction f).unit (.up ℕ)).app
          (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) ≫
          ((abelianPushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map L) ≫
        (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex s.hom (.up ℕ)).app R.cocomplex))
      ((abelianResolutionIso Y J p).hom x) =
    (abelianInjectiveResolutionIso X F R p).hom
      (Sheaf.H.map c p (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)).obj A) p x))
